rows.subtopic: Chemical Reactions of Aldehydes and Ketones
rows.text:
Consider the following reaction sequence,

\(\mathrm{CH_3CH_2COCl} \xrightarrow{\substack{\mathrm{Pd\text{-}BaSO_4} \\ \mathrm{H_2\ (1\ atm.)}}} \mathbf{P} \xrightarrow[\mathrm{(ii)\ H_3O^+}]{\mathrm{(i)\ MeMgBr}} \mathbf{Q} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{CrO_3}} \mathbf{R} \xrightarrow{\substack{\mathrm{Zn\text{-}Hg} \\ \mathrm{HCl}}} \mathbf{S}\)

and identify the correct statements:

(i) The products **P** and **R** can form addition product with HCN.
(ii) The product **Q** has no chiral center.
(iii) The product **R** can undergo Cannizzaro reaction.
(iv) The product **S** is a saturated hydrocarbon.

rows.text: The major product of the reaction of salicylaldehyde with one equivalent of MeMgBr, followed by acid neutralization is

figure.note: Four benzene-ring structures labelled I-IV. I: OH on one ring carbon and, ortho to it, CH(OH)CH3. II: OH and, ortho to it, CHO (2-hydroxybenzaldehyde). III: OMe and, ortho to it, CHO. IV: OH and, ortho to it, CHO, with CH3 on the ring carbon next to the CHO-bearing carbon (on the side away from OH).

Based on the relative stabilities and barriers, which among the following schematic energy diagrams would best correspond to the reaction scheme shown below? [\(k\) and \(k'\) are similar in magnitude]

\(\mathrm{X} \xrightleftharpoons[2k]{4k} \mathrm{Y} \xrightleftharpoons[3k']{8k'} \mathrm{Z}\)
options: Free energy against reaction coordinate: X on a shoulder, a high first barrier, Y in a shallow well below X, a small second barrier, Z lowest
Free energy against reaction coordinate: X in a well, a first barrier, Y in a well slightly above X, a second barrier higher than the first, Z in a well below X
Free energy against reaction coordinate: X in a well, a first barrier, Y in a well slightly below X, a second barrier higher than the first, Z lowest
